top_findings: Nine of 28 products lacked a home-link path
Unconfirmed preorders, shipping and returns in offers
Repeated buyer guides and indexable utility pages
quick_wins: Use checkout pricing for variant offers
Link relevant buyer guides and brands

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Apex redirects to www and missing products return 404.

findings.title: Incomplete discovery and URL controls
findings.description: Nine catalog products were unreachable from the live homepage.
findings.recommendation: Serve product links in HTML and self-canonicalize pagination.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Product names and scent notes are visible.

findings.title: Repeated buyer content
findings.description: Three sampled pages shared all 12 distinct long paragraphs.
findings.recommendation: Limit copy to relevant catalog facts and link matching fragrances.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: The product heading identifies the fragrance.

findings.title: Shared metadata and headings
findings.description: Retailer name repeated in titles and a shared logo added an H1.
findings.recommendation: Use a single page heading and unique titles.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: BDT offers are present and unsupported ratings are omitted.

findings.title: Unbacked full-bottle and policy offers
findings.description: Direct 10 ml entry selected 5 ml and a simulated stock change left stale offer markup.
findings.recommendation: Build variants from the same prices and stock used by the selector.

categories.name: Performance (mobile lab proxy)
what_works: Five live template medians were within the 2.5 second LCP threshold.

findings.title: Slow live shop LCP
findings.description: Live shop median LCP reached 4.260 seconds.
findings.recommendation: Measure again on production and monitor field data.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: The home browsing audit passed layout stability.

findings.title: Unnamed mobile controls
findings.description: Lighthouse agentic browsing scored 1/2 on the live home.
findings.recommendation: Label navigation, cart and search controls.

categories.name: Images
what_works: The product hero loaded and had a fragrance name.

findings.title: Pack image link label
findings.description: Pack collage links were identified by the discount or had no useful name.
findings.recommendation: Label pack links with the pack name.

phases.name: Implemented and verified locally
items: Catalog discovery, offers, shopper controls and content fixes completed

phases.name: Production verification
items: Repeat crawl, validate merchant results and inspect Google-selected canonicals

phases.name: Business data
items: Verify policies, concentrations, Niche assortment and analytics access

phases.name: Measurement
items: Compare Bangladesh organic clicks, queries, product impressions/CTR and attributable orders against the prior 28 days
